sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Tag pages (/tag/<tag>, /user/<name>/tag/<tag>) whose first section is Artists: the Release groups, Releases and Recordings tables were missing their "Artist" header, so every header from the second column on stood over the wrong column ("MB-Name" over the artist, "Comment" over the title, …), and the cover art card showed the artist as the title and no artist line.

Tag pages, including a single entity's (/tag/<tag>/release-group, …): the Comment column of a release group, release or recording no longer shows its artist's disambiguation ("Back in Black by AC/DC (Australian hard rock band)" had "Australian hard rock band" as Comment). Only the entity's own comment shows there.
